How these draws differ from the original website

New draws use the site's saved year-specific population weights to sample a location and its cohort's 15-year survival rate and mean lifespan to calibrate a simplified two-stage mortality model. Birth sex, marriage, offspring and causes are drawn from stated assumptions or saved cohort parameters. The two available historical cohorts are not a representative global birth-year sampler. Results are new fictional composites, not recovered real people, verified personal histories, or exact reproductions of Any Human Ever's server-side results.

“Replay a saved example” instead picks from the 11 PDF biographies you supplied. They are previously generated examples, not fresh draws from the live website.
